layer.name: Vacate orders (fire damage)
layer.description: HPD orders to vacate a building or part of one because of fire damage, 2012 on, with the rescind date when HPD has recorded one. Not on the map: 1 of 4,865 fire-damage orders (no usable coordinates). Not shown: 3,495 for illegal occupancy, 642 for habitability; those are housing matters, not a hazard this map tracks. Pulled 2026-11-14.
